sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为您打造了终极《办公室》粉丝播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office with exclusive interviews,
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会通过独家访谈深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: behind-the-scenes details, and lots of BFF stories.
sentences.zh: 分享幕后细节，还有许多我们闺蜜间的故事。

sentences.en: Today on Office Lady 6.0, Michael Scott's favorite concierge joins us.
sentences.zh: 今天在《办公室女士》6.0版中，迈克尔·斯科特最喜欢的礼宾员做客我们的节目。

sentences.en: It's Wendy McClendon-Covey, and she's in the studio with us.
sentences.zh: 她就是温迪·麦克伦登-考薇，她现在就在我们的演播室里。
哦，我太喜欢这次采访了。

sentences.en: Well, back when we were breaking down Business Trip in Season 5,
sentences.zh: 回想我们解析第五季《出差》那一集的时候，

sentences.en: Wendy sent us some audio clips about her time on the show as concierge Marie.
sentences.zh: 温迪给我们发来了一些关于她饰演礼宾员玛丽时的音频片段。

sentences.en: But today, we got to have her in studio with us,
sentences.zh: 但今天，我们终于能请她来到演播室，

sentences.en: and she is exactly as fun and funny as you imagine.
sentences.zh: 她本人和你们想象中一样有趣、幽默。

sentences.en: And, you guys, our breakdown of Business Trip is such a fun episode.
sentences.zh: 而且，各位，我们对《出差》这一集的解析非常精彩。

sentences.en: So if you haven't heard it, it's on our website, officeladies.com.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过，可以在我们的网站 officeladies.com 上找到。

sentences.en: Hot tip, at any point, if you ever want to go back and listen to an episode,
sentences.zh: 温馨提示，如果你想回头重听任何一集，
它们都在我们的网站上。

sentences.en: And Wendy is just fantastic in Business Trip.
sentences.zh: 温迪在《出差》里的表现非常出色。

sentences.en: But she's just crazy talented in every regard.
sentences.zh: 但她在各方面都才华横溢。

sentences.en: You might recognize her from her role as Beverly.
sentences.zh: 你可能在《戈德堡一家》中认出她饰演的贝弗利一角，
她在该剧中出演了十季，

sentences.en: she was nominated for two Critics' Choice Awards,
sentences.zh: 并获得了两次评论家选择奖提名，

sentences.en: or maybe you know her as Deputy Clementine Johnson from Reno 911,
sentences.zh: 或者你可能知道她在《雷诺911》中饰演的克莱门汀·约翰逊副警长，

sentences.en: the animated show Big City Greens,
sentences.zh: 还有动画片《大城市绿地》，

sentences.en: and she worked with our fellow Office alums,
sentences.zh: 她还与我们的《办公室》老同事，

sentences.en: Paul Feig and Ellie Kemper on Bridesmaids.
sentences.zh: 保罗·费格和艾丽·坎伯合作了《伴娘我最大》。

sentences.en: And now you can catch her on another hit television show
sentences.zh: 现在你可以在另一部热门电视剧中看到她，

sentences.en: with another member of our Office family,
sentences.zh: 该剧还有我们《办公室》大家庭的另一位成员，
编剧兼制片人贾斯汀·斯皮策。

sentences.en: She plays Hospital Administrator Joyce in St. Dennis Medical on NBC.
sentences.zh: 她在 NBC 的《圣丹尼斯医疗》中饰演医院行政主管乔伊斯。

sentences.en: And it's so good, you guys.
We're watching it and loving it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在追剧，非常喜欢。

sentences.en: She plays sort of the head nurse.
sentences.zh: 她饰演的是护士长之类的角色。
这是一部非常精彩的剧。

sentences.en: But then it also really packs a punch.
sentences.zh: 但它同时也很有冲击力。

sentences.en: If you're not watching it, I highly, highly recommend it.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没看，我强烈、强烈推荐你去看看。

sentences.en: You know, I met Alison one time, and she's so nice.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我曾见过艾莉森一次，她人特别好。
我们都是她的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: Lady, I hope we get a chance to talk to her someday.
sentences.zh: 天哪，希望我们以后有机会能和她聊聊。

sentences.en: I am angling to be on St. Dennis Medical.
sentences.zh: 我正想方设法争取在《圣丹尼斯医疗》里露个脸。

sentences.en: In fact, you guys, Jen and I are both pitching ourselves for different roles.
sentences.zh: 事实上，伙计们，我和简都在为不同的角色自荐。

sentences.en: Before we go to break, I thought we should have a little refresher
sentences.zh: 在进入广告时间之前，我想我们应该先来回顾一下
礼宾员玛丽的那些戏份。

sentences.en: So you guys remember, Michael is really down because Holly was transferred.
sentences.zh: 大家还记得吧，迈克尔因为霍莉被调走而情绪低落。

sentences.en: So David Wallace sends him and Oscar and Andy to Winnipeg to close a sale.
sentences.zh: 所以大卫·华莱士派他和奥斯卡、安迪去温尼伯谈成一笔生意。

sentences.en: And clearly, this is Michael's first time ever meeting a Concierge.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是迈克尔第一次见到礼宾员。

sentences.en: And he is, in his own words, blown away.
sentences.zh: 用他自己的话说，他被彻底震撼了。

sentences.en: Wallace said there would be one of those.
sentences.zh: 华莱士说会有那种人的。

sentences.en: What about a nice sushi place?
sentences.zh: 有什么不错的寿司店吗？

sentences.en: Maybe a place with a view?
You may walk there if you wish.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，可以步行前往。

sentences.en: Or you may take the number 17 bus until 9 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以在九点前乘坐17路公交车。

sentences.en: Other than that, you can take the taxi and the number is right there.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，你可以打车，号码就在那儿。

sentences.en: Where might you find yourself on a Winnipeg night like tonight?
sentences.zh: 像今晚这样的温尼伯之夜，你会去哪儿呢？
迈克尔太容易被满足了。

sentences.en: He's enamored by all of it.
Like, the travel, the hotel, the concierge.
sentences.zh: 比如旅行、酒店、礼宾员什么的。

sentences.en: And the way Wendy is playing the concierge, it's just like, it's so rote.
sentences.zh: 而且温迪扮演礼宾员的方式，简直就是……太刻板了。

sentences.en: Like, how many times has she recommended these restaurants?
sentences.zh: 话说，她到底推荐过多少次这些餐厅了？

sentences.en: Well, as the night goes on, they have drinks.
sentences.zh: 随着夜色渐深，他们喝了点酒。

sentences.en: And Michael continues to be very impressed.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔依然对她印象深刻。

sentences.en: And you need to get some dry cleaning done.
sentences.zh: 而你又急着要干洗衣服。

sentences.en: Oh, Astro Cleaners on St. James Place is the only place that is open on that day.
sentences.zh: 噢，圣詹姆斯广场的Astro干洗店是那天唯一开门的店。

sentences.en: Michael is, he is so turned on by her knowledge.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，他完全被她的博学迷住了。

sentences.en: She knows where the dry cleaners are at any point of any day.
sentences.zh: 她竟然知道任何时间、任何地点的干洗店在哪里。

sentences.en: She knows where you can go.
I love the storyline so much.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个故事线了。

sentences.en: And I loved our conversation with Wendy.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢我们和温迪的谈话。
她真的是个很特别的人。

sentences.en: And I can't wait for everyone to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想让大家听听了。

sentences.en: And when we come back, Wendy is in the studio.
sentences.zh: 回来之后，温迪就会来到演播室。

sentences.en: Oh, my head's going to explode with happiness.
sentences.zh: 噢，我的头都要因为幸福而炸开了。

sentences.en: I've been so looking forward to this.
sentences.zh: 我一直非常期待这一刻。

sentences.en: I have been looking forward to it as well.
And I can't believe I'm looking at you.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信我就在你面前。

sentences.en: When you got here, we were reflecting on the last time we saw one another in person.
sentences.zh: 你刚到的时候，我们还在回想上次见面时的情景。

sentences.en: Because you were on The Office, but we were not in your scenes.
sentences.zh: 因为你演过《办公室》，但我们没在你的戏份里出现过。

sentences.en: And so you remembered the last time we saw each other.
sentences.zh: 所以你还记得我们上次见面是什么时候。

sentences.en: It was called The Fur Ball.
And it was like a kitty rescue fundraiser.
sentences.zh: 是个小猫救援的筹款活动。

sentences.en: And you were one of the hosts, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我记得你当时是主持人之一。

sentences.en: I worked with Kitten Rescue, who puts on that fundraiser for years.
sentences.zh: 我跟“小猫救援”组织合作过，他们多年来一直举办那个筹款活动。

sentences.en: And that's one of the many reasons why I love you guys is because you care about the little creatures.
sentences.zh: 这也是我喜欢你们的众多原因之一，因为你们很关心那些小生灵。

sentences.en: Yes, and so do you, because if you follow you on Instagram, Wendy, you know your love of critters.
sentences.zh: 没错，你也是，温迪，如果你关注了你的Instagram，就会知道你有多爱小动物。

sentences.en: They are all around our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 它们在我们社区到处都是。

sentences.en: And the carnage that happens in our flower beds is not pretty.
sentences.zh: 而且它们在我们花坛里造成的杀戮场面可一点都不好看。

sentences.en: We were doing an edit session recently, and out my window, we were—remember Cassie, Angela?
sentences.zh: 我们最近在做剪辑，我从窗户往外看，我们当时——安吉拉，你还记得凯西吗？

sentences.en: We were on Zoom, and all of a sudden, it was like a bird exploded in front of my window.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在开Zoom会议，突然间，就像有一只鸟在我的窗前炸开了一样。

sentences.en: And I think it's because a big, like, hawk came down.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是因为有一只大老鹰俯冲了下来。
我后院也发生过这种事。
就像羽毛做的五彩纸屑一样。

sentences.en: And there's nothing you can do.
That was just Mother Nature sorting some stuff out.
sentences.zh: 那只是大自然在处理一些事情而已。

sentences.en: But it's a little brutal to watch.
I didn't know we were going to start this way.
sentences.zh: 我没想到我们会以这种话题开始。

sentences.en: I was about to tell a story about when I watched a squirrel eat a hummingbird, and then I didn't realize squirrels eat hummingbirds.
sentences.zh: 我本来想讲个故事，关于我看到一只松鼠吃掉了一只蜂鸟，我之前都不知道松鼠会吃蜂鸟。

sentences.en: And then I decided not to tell it, and now I'm saying it out loud.
sentences.zh: 后来我决定不讲了，结果现在还是说了出来。

sentences.en: Well, listen, nature is disgusting, and I prefer it when nature stays outside.
sentences.zh: 听着，大自然是很恶心的，我更希望大自然待在外面。

sentences.en: But squirrel is a great, great event.
sentences.zh: 不过松鼠那件事是个很棒的活动。

sentences.en: I still have a teapot I bid on at that auction.
sentences.zh: 我到现在还留着在那场拍卖会上竞拍到的茶壶。

sentences.en: And it's a cat, and the head comes off, and then you put it on, and the water comes out its mouth.
sentences.zh: 那是个猫咪造型的，头可以拿下来，盖上之后，水会从它嘴里流出来。

sentences.en: I hope you use it all the time.
Only for my friends when they come over.
sentences.zh: 只在朋友过来的时候才用。

sentences.en: So, Wendy, when you come over, get ready.
sentences.zh: 所以，温迪，等你过来的时候，做好准备吧。

sentences.en: I'll remember that you said that.
Wendy, we know that you sent in some audio clips when we broke down your episode, Business Trip.
sentences.zh: 温迪，我们知道在你那集《出差》的解析节目里，你发来过一些音频片段。

sentences.en: But we're just so excited to have you in studio.
sentences.zh: 但我们真的非常高兴能请你来演播室。

sentences.en: Will you tell us again the story of how you got your job on the office?
sentences.zh: 你能再给我们讲讲你是怎么得到《办公室》那份工作的吗？

sentences.en: So, it was kind of crazy.
I had just been fired off a movie that I had auditioned.
sentences.zh: 我刚被一部我试镜过的电影解雇了。

sentences.en: I had done all these things.
sentences.zh: 我之前做了所有那些准备工作。

sentences.en: They flew me out to Michigan.
sentences.zh: 他们把我飞到了密歇根州。

sentences.en: Got in the passenger van to go to set, and the money guy decided I was not pretty enough to do the role.
sentences.zh: 坐上客货车去片场时，投资人觉得我长得不够漂亮，不适合那个角色。

sentences.en: So, I was put on a plane crying to go right back to L.A.
sentences.zh: 于是，我就被送上飞机，哭着飞回了洛杉矶。

sentences.en: You get to set, and they say, I'm sorry, that's it?
sentences.zh: 你到了片场，然后他们说，抱歉，就这样？

sentences.en: Don't go to your dressing room.
It was pretty brutal, and yet a blessing, because that movie went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 确实挺残忍的，但也是一种福气，因为那部电影后来没激起任何水花。

sentences.en: And I would have had to be in Michigan for seven weeks waiting to film for only five days.
sentences.zh: 而且我本来得在密歇根待上七周，就为了拍那五天的戏。
这就是宇宙的运作方式。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes you're in the wrong place, and something horrible has to happen to get you in the right place.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时候你身处错误的地方，必须发生一些糟糕的事情，才能把你带到正确的地方。

sentences.en: So, when I land in L.A., I look at my phone, and my phone's blowing up, because I had gotten an offer to do The Office the next day.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我降落在洛杉矶时，我看了看手机，手机炸开了锅，因为我收到了第二天去拍《办公室》的邀约。

sentences.en: So, thank God I got fired, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，谢天谢地我被解雇了，对吧？

sentences.en: Because nobody saw that movie, but everybody saw this.
sentences.zh: 因为没人看过那部电影，但所有人都看了这部剧。
你能说出那部电影的名字吗？

sentences.en: We're going to do a special podcast called Office Ladies Burn It to the Ground when we're in our late 60s.
sentences.zh: 等我们六十多岁的时候，我们要录一期特别播客，叫《办公室女士：彻底揭秘》。

sentences.en: Yes, and then I'll name names.
sentences.zh: 好的，到时候我会指名道姓。

sentences.en: Because we have some stories to tell, but we're putting them in our pocket for a few years.
sentences.zh: 因为我们确实有些故事要讲，但我们先把它藏在心里几年。

sentences.en: When we're really old and give zero Fs, we're going to burn it down.
sentences.zh: 等我们老到完全不在乎的时候，我们要把这里烧个精光。

sentences.en: I'll bring the tequila for that episode.
sentences.zh: 那一集我会带龙舌兰酒去。

sentences.en: So, anyway, my whole thing was with Steve Carell, and we were in Winnipeg.
sentences.zh: 总之，我当时是和史蒂夫·卡瑞尔一起，我们在温尼伯。

sentences.en: So, I didn't get to meet you guys, which was stinky.
sentences.zh: 所以我没能见到你们，真是太糟糕了。

sentences.en: So, we're filming at a hotel somewhere in L.A.
sentences.zh: 当时我们在洛杉矶某处的酒店拍摄。

sentences.en: Kate Flannery drove by and said hello, so that was cute.
sentences.zh: 凯特·弗兰纳里开车经过时跟我打了招呼，那感觉真好。

sentences.en: And then—okay, so it was on a Friday.
sentences.zh: 然后——好吧，那是周五的事。

sentences.en: And during lunch, I'm in my trailer eating.
sentences.zh: 午饭时间，我正在拖车里吃饭。

sentences.en: I get a call that I'm not going to be on Reno anymore.
sentences.zh: 我接到电话说我不用再演《雷诺911》了。

sentences.en: So, I am sobbing in my trailer.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在拖车里嚎啕大哭。

sentences.en: Was on the set of The Office.
I mean, I was like, well, now I'm going to get fired from this job because I can't collect myself.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当时想，完了，我现在要因为无法控制情绪而被这份工作开除了。

sentences.en: But the experience was so fun.
sentences.zh: 但那次经历真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And Steve Carell is a doll.
sentences.zh: 而且史蒂夫·卡瑞尔真是个好人。

sentences.en: I love the way the episode turned out.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢那一集呈现出来的效果。

sentences.en: I loved, like, I'm in my full uniform, but no shoes on.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种感觉，我穿着全套制服，但没穿鞋。

sentences.en: Like, what did we do in there?
sentences.zh: 就像，我们在里面做了什么？
因为你已经穿好衣服了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I got dressed in a hurry to throw his shoes out the door.
sentences.zh: 对，我匆忙穿好衣服，把他的鞋子扔出门外。

sentences.en: Was I just on a break and had to go back down to my desk?
sentences.zh: 我当时只是在休息，然后必须回到我的办公桌前吗？

sentences.en: We want to know where that hotel room came from.
sentences.zh: 我们想知道那个酒店房间是怎么来的。

sentences.en: I guess you set that up.
You didn't go to his room.
No, it was my, like, little lair or something.
sentences.zh: 没有，那就像是我的小窝之类的。

sentences.en: You know how, like, though, at hotels, they have that room where if you have a layover and you're like, hey, can I just go shower somewhere?
sentences.zh: 你知道酒店里通常有那种房间，如果你中转停留，你可以问，嘿，我能在哪里洗个澡吗？

sentences.en: I don't know about the layover room.
sentences.zh: 我不知道什么中转房间。

sentences.en: I had a layover and I got a room, like, just for a few hours so I could shower.
sentences.zh: 我当时转机，就开了个房间，也就待几个小时，为了洗个澡。

sentences.en: Well, it was right off the airport.
But I used to work at a hotel as well.
sentences.zh: 但我以前也在酒店工作过。

sentences.en: And everybody knows, like, okay, let me look up.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，就是，好吧，让我查查看。

sentences.en: Oh, there's a room on the corner that nobody's in.
sentences.zh: 哦，角落里有个没人住的房间。

sentences.en: If you want to go have a hookup.
sentences.zh: 如果你想去约个炮的话。

sentences.en: And the employees would do this.
But, yes, they would do that.
sentences.zh: 但没错，他们确实会那样做。

sentences.en: That is some good hospitality gossip.
sentences.zh: 这可是些不错的酒店业八卦。

sentences.en: What did you do in the hotel business?
sentences.zh: 你在酒店业是做什么的？

sentences.en: I was a secretary back when they called them secretaries.
sentences.zh: 我以前做过秘书，那时候还叫秘书。

sentences.en: And then I became, like, a salesperson for corporate sales.
sentences.zh: 后来我成了企业销售部的销售人员。

sentences.en: I tried to get people to come and stay in our shitty little hotel.
sentences.zh: 我得想方设法让人来住我们那家破烂小酒店。

sentences.en: So this was—I worked at a place near Disneyland.
sentences.zh: 当时我是在迪士尼乐园附近的一家酒店工作。

sentences.en: It was, like, the third worst Ramada in Anaheim.
sentences.zh: 那大概是阿纳海姆排名倒数第三差的华美达酒店。

sentences.en: And it was just far enough—it was literally across train tracks from the rest of—
sentences.zh: 而且位置偏得刚好——它就在铁轨对面，离其他——

sentences.en: Where tourist Anaheim turns into industrial Anaheim.
sentences.zh: 就是旅游区的阿纳海姆变成工业区阿纳海姆的地方。

sentences.en: So this was basically a trucker hotel.
sentences.zh: 所以那基本上就是个卡车司机旅馆。

sentences.en: But we were trying to make it into a destination property.

sentences.zh: 温迪，你的演员背景故事是什么样的？

sentences.zh: 很小的时候就有，但我直到26岁结婚后才真正开始认真追求它。

sentences.en: So that's when, you know, because my husband was like, yeah, do it.
sentences.zh: 所以就是那时候，因为我丈夫说，去吧，去做吧。

sentences.zh: 我在南海岸剧团上过课，但我没有完成整个剧团的项目。

sentences.zh: 当时心想我总会回去的，就觉得，哦，我先做这个等着。

sentences.zh: 然后我就遇到了志同道合的人，我爱上了那里。

sentences.zh: 也就是在那里我遇到了凯特·弗兰纳里，因为我们一起演了一场叫《婊子星球》的戏。
我敢打赌那一定很前卫。

sentences.en: Don't you miss those days, though?
Doing these silly little shows and begging people to come and, you know, getting so many
sentences.zh: 做这些傻乎乎的小演出，求着别人来看，你知道，还吃了

sentences.en: So you were going to just stay there and ride it out.
sentences.zh: 所以你本来打算就待在那儿，一直做下去。

sentences.en: Yeah, and, like, when my time's up, my time's up.
sentences.zh: 是啊，而且，如果我的时间到了，那就到了。

sentences.en: But then I got in the company, which was nice.
sentences.zh: 但后来我进了公司，那挺好的。

sentences.en: But then I started working, and I couldn't do as many shows as I wanted to.
sentences.zh: 但后来我开始工作了，就没法像以前那样参加那么多演出。

sentences.en: So, but that's how that happened.
sentences.zh: 所以，事情就是这样发生的。

sentences.zh: 当时我很沮丧，因为我想，好吧，也许我开始得太晚了。

sentences.zh: 总之，后来我替别人在一部剧中演出，就这样我被发掘去参加了

sentences.en: How old were you when you got Reno?
Does that feel kind of like a big milestone break?
sentences.zh: 那感觉算是一个重大的里程碑吗？

sentences.en: Like, yeah, that was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 算是吧，那确实是一件大事。

sentences.en: But it was like, you know, basic cable.
sentences.zh: 但那毕竟只是基础有线电视节目。

sentences.en: I mean, it was like just going and doing arts and crafts with your friends, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那感觉就像是和朋友们一起做手工活一样，你知道的。

sentences.en: But I feel like people keep finding it, don't you?
sentences.zh: 但我感觉人们一直在发现它，你不觉得吗？

sentences.en: It's never been off the air.
Like your show will never be off the air.
sentences.zh: 就像你的节目永远不会停播一样。

sentences.en: So people keep coming to it in waves, and it's always a new discovery.
sentences.zh: 所以人们一波又一波地涌向它，它总是一个新的发现。

sentences.en: It's like the documentary film crew has found a new subject, and it's a small newspaper company.
sentences.zh: 就像纪录片摄制组找到了一个新的拍摄对象，那是一家小型报社。

sentences.en: That's kind of just dying, this paper industry.
sentences.zh: 那是一个正在消亡的行业，报纸行业。

sentences.en: So it's like the idea is that it's like the same people who made the documentary of Dunder Mifflin
sentences.zh: 所以构思是，制作邓德·米夫林纪录片的同一批人

sentences.en: are making this documentary of the small paper company and following the employees the way they did before.
sentences.zh: 正在制作这家小型报社的纪录片，并像以前一样跟踪拍摄员工。

sentences.en: But there's not currently any like, it's not our characters.
sentences.zh: 但目前并没有，就是说，不是我们原来的角色。

sentences.en: Like Pam Beasley doesn't show up or anything.
sentences.zh: 比如帕姆·比斯利不会出现之类的。

sentences.en: So the through line is the documentary crew, not the people from Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 所以贯穿始终的是纪录片摄制组，而不是邓德·米夫林的人。

sentences.en: I feel like Reno 911 also has the benefit of being very like, you can make really fun clips out of it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得《雷诺 911》还有一个优势，就是你可以从中剪辑出非常有趣的短片。

sentences.en: It pops up on my Instagram all the time.
sentences.zh: 它经常出现在我的 Instagram 上。

sentences.en: I mean, how many times have I seen your bit where you're doing the, you know what I'm going to say, probably, the dancing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我看了多少次你跳舞的那个片段了，你知道我要说什么，大概就是那个舞蹈。

sentences.en: And that was one of the first things I ever did for that show.
sentences.zh: 那是我为那个节目做的第一批事情之一。

sentences.en: And then we got to, you guys remember when Quibi came out, right?
sentences.zh: 然后我们到了，你们记得Quibi刚出来的时候吧？

sentences.en: So we got to resurrect it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得以让它稍微复活了一下。

sentences.en: And because of that, we, you know, we did a bunch of other episodes that folded while we were on set.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我们在片场拍摄的时候，又拍了一堆其他剧集，结果那些剧集都黄了。

sentences.en: It went out of business whilst we were filming.
sentences.zh: 就在我们拍摄的时候它倒闭了。

sentences.en: But we just kept going because we figured, well, someone's going to pick it up.
sentences.zh: 但我们还是继续拍，因为我们想，总会有人接手的。

sentences.en: So then we knocked out a bunch of episodes and two more movies.
sentences.zh: 于是我们一口气拍了好几集，还有两部电影。

sentences.en: So it's like the gift that keeps giving and whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是那种源源不断的礼物之类的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm thrilled that I get to, you know, hang out and play with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我是说，能和朋友们一起玩，我感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: But it's just weird how things are cyclical like that.
sentences.zh: 但事情以这种方式循环往复，真的很奇怪。

sentences.zh: 如果是的话，你还记得哪一场戏是你最难忍住不笑的吗？

sentences.zh: 我确实记得他在问问题时即兴发挥了一些，因为他能和礼宾员在一起感到非常兴奋。

sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，在我去过温尼伯之后，整件事对我来说变得更有趣了，因为那里什么都没有。

sentences.en: Well, you know, and after I visited Winnipeg, that whole thing became so much more funny to me because there's just nothing there.
sentences.zh: 但我记得当时心想，千万别笑场，因为你能在这里拍戏很幸运。

sentences.en: But I remember thinking, don't break because you are lucky to be here.

sentences.zh: 而你必须和他们俩一起演戏。

sentences.en: And you had to be in scenes with both of them.

sentences.zh: 艾德·赫尔姆斯会笑场的。

sentences.en: But those two are like statues.
sentences.zh: 但那两位就像雕像一样。

sentences.en: Because he had a recurring thing on Reno.
sentences.zh: 因为他在《雷诺911》里有个常驻角色。

sentences.en: And he would say these things, and I would be, like, having a nosebleed trying not to laugh.
sentences.zh: 他会说出那些话，我当时简直要流鼻血了，拼命忍住不笑。

sentences.en: Like, I'm going to have an aneurysm if I can't let this out.
sentences.zh: 就像是，如果我再不笑出来，我都要脑溢血了。

sentences.en: And when someone raises the bar like that, you just can't.
sentences.zh: 当有人把标准提得那么高时，你真的没法做到。

sentences.zh: 我不能毁了这一条拍摄。

sentences.zh: 嗯，我们有过这种经历，我们不得不避免和史蒂夫进行眼神交流。

sentences.zh: 这让我很惊讶，因为你们俩当时看起来完全沉浸在角色里。

sentences.zh: 听到你们说你们才是最容易笑场的人，我非常惊讶。

sentences.en: Well, we couldn't be next to each other.

sentences.en: You know, like, so then they just started putting us apart.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以后来他们就开始把我们分开了。

sentences.en: You know, like, we had to just, like, stare at him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们只能那样盯着他看。

sentences.en: And you stare at him so well.
sentences.zh: 而且你盯着他看的样子演得真好。

sentences.zh: 但你觉得她为什么会和他好上？

sentences.zh: 我们确实收到了关于这个的问题。

sentences.zh: 她为什么会被迈克尔吸引？

She'll give you a date, and you're like, all right.
sentences.zh: 她会给你定个日期，然后你就会觉得，好吧。

sentences.en: We're going to feature this outfit on Office Lady.
sentences.zh: 我们要把这套行头放到《办公室女士》节目里展示。
当然，它会用胶带粘起来。

sentences.en: No one's going to see that tape.
sentences.zh: 没人会看到那些胶带的。

sentences.en: Do you have a favorite midnight snack?
No, because I don't eat after, like, seven.
sentences.zh: 没有，因为我大概七点以后就不吃东西了。

sentences.en: That's very good for your body.
I do have a midnight drink that I like, which is very silly.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一种喜欢的深夜饮品，这很傻。

sentences.en: I'm a terrible insomniac, so my sleep, I have to, like, really be regimented about it.
sentences.zh: 我严重失眠，所以我的睡眠，我必须得非常有规律才行。

sentences.en: But there's this magnesium drink, this berry-flavored magnesium drink that is delicious,
sentences.zh: 但有一种镁饮品，那种浆果味的镁饮品非常美味，

sentences.en: and it makes you feel like hot butter melting in a pan.
sentences.zh: 喝了感觉就像热黄油在平底锅里融化一样。

sentences.en: You should write this down, lady.

sentences.zh: 我也深受睡眠问题的困扰。

sentences.en: Magnesium or what's the other thing?
sentences.zh: 是镁还是别的什么东西？

sentences.en: It's got to build up in your system.
You got to take it, like, an hour before you're ready to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 你得在准备睡觉前一小时喝它。

sentences.en: Lady, I wrote it down for you.
We're ladies in a certain season.
sentences.zh: 我们都是处于特定人生阶段的女性。

sentences.en: Otherwise, what are you going to do?
Thinking about all the things you shouldn't have said during the day?
sentences.zh: 想着白天那些不该说的话？

sentences.en: You got to just melt into the sheets.
sentences.zh: 你得让自己彻底陷进被窝里。

sentences.en: Now, will this keep you asleep all night as well?
sentences.zh: 那这东西能让你整晚都睡得着吗？

sentences.en: Will this magnesium drink keep you asleep all night?
sentences.zh: 这种镁饮品能让你整晚都睡得着吗？

sentences.en: Because one of my problems is like, oh, sure, I'll fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 因为我的问题之一是，哦，当然，我能睡着。

sentences.en: But in three hours, you're going to wake up.
sentences.zh: 但三个小时后，你就会醒来。

sentences.en: I'm going to wake up from a hot flash.
Then it's a whole, we start the whole game.
sentences.zh: 然后就没完没了，我们又得重新开始那场游戏。

sentences.en: The game called Will and Fall Asleep Again.
sentences.zh: 那场叫“能不能再次入睡”的游戏。

sentences.en: I would guarantee you're going to get at least four good hours.
sentences.zh: 我敢保证你至少能睡上四个小时好觉。

sentences.en: Hot flashes are its own devil.
sentences.zh: 潮热真是个磨人的小妖精。

sentences.en: Do you turn the air on?
So I sleep with a fan blowing on my side of the bed.
sentences.zh: 所以我睡觉时会在床边开个风扇。

sentences.en: We need to put a piece of glow tape on it because I need it positioned like really kind
sentences.zh: 我们需要在上面贴块荧光胶带，因为我得把它摆在床正前方，

sentences.en: of right in front of the bed, but it's also right in the walkway to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 但它正好挡在去洗手间的过道上。

sentences.en: Oh, so you run into it all the time.
sentences.zh: 噢，所以你们总是会撞到它。

sentences.en: But if my husband has to go to the bathroom, he runs into it.
sentences.zh: 但如果我丈夫半夜要去洗手间，他就会撞到。

sentences.en: If the kids come in in the middle of the night, they run into it.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子们半夜跑进来，他们也会撞到。

sentences.en: So, like, this is like a ridiculous—
sentences.zh: 所以，这简直是个荒唐的——

sentences.en: And that's going to wake you up, too, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 而且那也会把你吵醒，对吧？

sentences.en: So we just, we need to, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是，我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: And at night, I'll say, hey, everybody, don't run into the fan.
sentences.zh: 晚上我会叮嘱大家，嘿，别撞到风扇。

sentences.en: If you have to come in, don't remember, don't run into mom's fan.
sentences.zh: 如果你们要进来，记得别撞到妈妈的风扇。

sentences.en: Wendy, thank you so much for being on our podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 温迪，非常感谢你来参加我们的播客。

sentences.en: I hope I didn't bloviate for too long.
You did not bloviate at all.
You are just, you're just a badass.
You are so funny and so smart.
And we are just thrilled to just have had this time with you.
sentences.zh: 能有这段时间和你交流，我们感到非常激动。
你们才是真正厉害的人。

sentences.en: I really appreciate how vulnerable you were in talking about, like, how you've been fired.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你愿意敞开心扉，谈论你被解雇的经历。

sentences.en: I've shared on the podcast before how I've been fired.
sentences.zh: 我之前也在播客里分享过我被解雇的事。

sentences.en: And it's like, because I think people look at you and we see all the successes.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得人们看着你时，只看到了你所有的成功。

sentences.en: We see 10 seasons of the Goldbergs and Reno 911, and you don't see all the, like, lows.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了《戈德堡一家》和《雷诺911》的十季演出，却看不到你经历过的那些低谷。

sentences.en: And I think it's really helpful for aspiring artists to know there are ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 我觉得让有志向的艺术家们知道演艺生涯有起有落，真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And you just keep going, and you never know.
sentences.zh: 你只需要坚持下去，你永远不知道未来会怎样。

sentences.en: And new, wonderful things will find you.
sentences.zh: 新的美好事物总会找到你。

sentences.en: And, I mean, now here's St. Dennis Medical.
sentences.zh: 而且，你看，现在有了《圣丹尼斯医疗》。

sentences.en: You know, there's like an actor's checkliSt.
Like, you're going to get fired.
sentences.zh: 比如，你迟早会被解雇的。

sentences.en: You're just going to get fired.
sentences.zh: 你只会落得被解雇的下场。

sentences.en: Someone's going to tell you you're ugly.
None of this stuff is true unless you think it's true.
sentences.zh: 除非你自己相信，否则这些话都不是真的。
但它们大概率不是真的。

sentences.en: Like, just get used to it.
If you're not supposed to be somewhere, sometimes it takes something terrible to move you away from it.
sentences.zh: 如果你本不该待在某个地方，有时需要发生点可怕的事才能让你离开。

sentences.en: And so then it makes you question, do I really want to keep doing this?
sentences.zh: 这会让你反思，我真的想继续做下去吗？

sentences.en: And if the answer is yes, buck up and just keep going.
sentences.zh: 如果答案是肯定的，那就振作起来，继续前进。

sentences.en: And a lot of times, your biggest breakthrough won't happen until something catastrophic happens.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，你最大的突破往往是在灾难发生之后才出现的。

sentences.en: That's like a hallmark of good things to come.
sentences.zh: 这就像是好事将近的标志。

sentences.en: So all you guys out there that are feeling like you want to do this, it's not easy, but it is very fun.
sentences.zh: 所以，你们这些想做这行的人，虽然不容易，但真的很有趣。

sentences.en: The good times are really, really good.
sentences.zh: 美好的时光真的非常、非常美好。

sentences.en: And you appreciate them because of the journey.
sentences.zh: 而且正因为经历了这段旅程，你才会倍加珍惜。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, that was our chat with Wendy McLendon-Covey, and I loved it.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，以上就是我们与温迪·麦克伦登-科维的谈话，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: She's just so funny, like, just in person, just like how she talks and her stories.
sentences.zh: 她本人真的太幽默了，无论是说话方式还是讲故事的样子。

sentences.en: And anyway, wow, what a treat.
And of course, Angela is going to share all the links to all the things that we talked about.
sentences.zh: 当然，安吉拉会分享我们谈到的所有内容的链接。

sentences.en: And you have to check out St. Dennis Medical.
sentences.zh: 你们一定要去看看《圣丹尼斯医疗中心》。

sentences.en: It is a phenomenal cast, a great show.
sentences.zh: 演员阵容非常强大，是一部很棒的剧。

sentences.en: And we are so excited for season two.
Thank you for writing in your questions, and we will see you next week.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家写信提问，我们下周见。
